- **क्या-क्या अलग हुआ (deviations summary):** बड़ा scope deviation कोई नहीं — सब plan के अनुसार। छोटे functional changes: 50 LS-native templates hardcoded (Phase 2 swap), PDF renderer hand-rolled (zero new deps), profile schema JSON-namespaced (no migration), Figma+Storybook deliberately टाले गए (TypeScript + Jest cover किया), real Razorpay/cron/FTS Phase 2 — सब के liye contract test-pinned है ताकि swap-in safe हो।

- **अब क्या करना है (next steps):** 1️⃣ Staging VPS provision (₹500/month), 2️⃣ Production env vars set करो (RAZORPAY_*, AISENSY_API_KEY, SENTRY_DSN, B2_*), 3️⃣ Final LS Postgres dump T-7 दिन पर, 4️⃣ Migration dry-run staging पर चलाओ, 5️⃣ `MIGRATION_REPORT.md` review करो (orphans, row counts, spot-checks), 6️⃣ Sunday 2am IST cutover schedule, 7️⃣ Cron registration (daily/weekly/monthly email, payout flush, timeout sweep), 8️⃣ `rollback_to_ls.sh --dry-run` से 60-sec flip confirm करो, 9️⃣ Cutover Sunday सुबह 5 trainers + 5 task submits smoke test, 10 बजे maintenance banner remove. **Production-cutover-ready ✅**.
